rows.text: At 11:04 on Monday 21 April 1997 the Speaker told the House that the swearing-in ceremony had just concluded and that the Prime Minister and ministers needed time to arrive, and adjourned to 11:30.

locator.page_heading: XI Lok Sabha Debates, Session IV (Budget), Monday, April 21, 1997
locator.speaker: Mr. Speaker

rows.text: When the House reassembled at 11:31 on 21 April 1997 the Speaker introduced the Prime Minister of India, I. K. Gujral, and invited him to introduce his Council of Ministers.
